entry.title: Vulcan Rotary 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Vulcan Rotary 1.0.1 Fixes #1: the 1.0.0 packages shipped `plugin_list.awk` with Windows (CRLF) line endings, so the installer's awk failed on the device and the plugin never registered. - `plugin_list.awk` is now LF. Verified with `catalog_check.py` from open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins (OK, 0 warnings, both architectures). - Plugin binaries and skins are byte-for-byte the same as 1.0.0.
